dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Pedro. I'm representing Brazil at this meeting.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ˈpeɪdroʊ. aɪm ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntɪŋ brəˈzɪl ət ðɪs ˈmiːtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Nam, and I'm representing Thailand. What's your topic?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs tə ˈmiːt juː. aɪm ˈnɑːm, ənd aɪm ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntɪŋ ˈtaɪlænd. ˈwʌts jʊr ˈtɑːpɪk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Migration. More and more people are moving from the countryside to the cities.
dialogue.reading: maɪˈɡreɪʃən. ˈmɔːr ənd ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl ər ˈmuːvɪŋ frəm ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd tə ðə ˈsɪtiz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's the same in Thailand. Bangkok is getting more and more crowded.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ðə ˈseɪm ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmɔːr ənd ˈmɔːr ˈkraʊdɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And urban life is getting more and more expensive, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈɜːrbən ˈlaɪf ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmɔːr ənd ˈmɔːr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Rents are getting higher and higher, so inequality is growing.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈrɛnts ər ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈhaɪər ənd ˈhaɪər, soʊ ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti ɪz ˈɡroʊɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Refugees. More and more people are leaving their homes because of conflict and climate change.
dialogue.reading: ˌrɛfjuˈdʒiːz. ˈmɔːr ənd ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl ər ˈliːvɪŋ ðɛr ˈhoʊmz bɪˈkɔːz əv ˈkɑːnflɪkt ənd ˈklaɪmət ˌtʃeɪndʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In some places, yes. The refugee camps are getting bigger and bigger every year.
dialogue.reading: ɪn sʌm ˈpleɪsɪz, ˈjɛs. ðə ˌrɛfjuˈdʒiː ˈkæmps ər ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈbɪɡər ənd ˈbɪɡər ˈɛvri ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What do you think countries should do?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk ˈkʌntriz ʃʊd ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Work together. No country can solve a crisis like this on its own.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɜːrk təˈɡɛðər. ˈnoʊ ˈkʌntri kən ˈsɑːlv ə ˈkraɪsɪs ˈlaɪk ðɪs ɑːn ɪts ˈoʊn.
